comment: How long a message may stay in progress before it is retried.
modal: The waiting period after which a message still marked as in progress is released and retried, so stalled messages are not lost.

comment: How long successfully processed messages are kept before cleanup removes them.
modal: The retention period for messages that have been processed successfully, after which the queue cleanup removes them.

comment: How long failed messages are kept before cleanup removes them.
modal: The retention period for messages that failed processing, after which the queue cleanup removes them.

comment: How long new, unprocessed messages are kept before cleanup removes them.
modal: The retention period for new messages that have not yet been processed, after which the queue cleanup removes them.
